articleTitle: Special characteristics of reliability for serial mechatronic systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The study characterizes the basic distributions of damages in elements included in the mechatronic devices: exponential, Weibull, normal, log-normal distributions. It considers some special cases, when suitability times of elements for the mechatronic system have the above four distributions, and the mechatronic device's system is created by three elements of a serial structure and various types of time distributions for elements' suitability. The order of elements is not important. The final section of this work presents a case, when four elements work in the serial structure. Suitability times of these elements have different types of distributions.

Author Keywords: distributions of damages for multiple systems

articleTitle: Inductive coupled contactless energy transfer systems - a review
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The basic principles and the latest developments of contactless energy transfer techniques with special focus on inductively coupled solutions have been systematically described in this paper. The advantages and limitations have been briefly examined, and the application field where each technique is particularly suited has been indicated. The bidirectional inductive power transfer (IPT) system developed by authors in the Electrotechnical Institute, Warsaw, has been described and some oscillograms that illustrate properties of the 15 kW laboratory model are shown.

articleTitle: The impact of vibration of the 3D printer table on the quality of print
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The article presents the results of measurements carried out for the 3D Kreator Motion printer table in terms of analysis of impact of mechanical vibrations on print quality. The article presents an analysis of the mechanical vibrations in the plane perpendicular to the surface of the table. The measurements were obtained using laser measurement techniques.

articleTitle: Influence of an end-winding size on proximity losses in a high-speed PM synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This paper deals with AC winding loss including proximity loss investigation in a high-speed permanent magnet (PM) machine for traction applications. The research is focused on the end-winding effects that have not been widely reported in the literature. The calculated results confirm that the end-winding copper loss can significantly affect the eddy-current loss within copper and it must be taken into account to provide reasonable prediction of total losses. A three-dimensional (3D) finite element analysis (FEA) is employed to evaluate and identify the end-winding contribution into the overall winding power loss generated. To explain how much the power loss may change due to dimensions and size of end-winding, the parameterized 3D FE models are investigated. In this study, the results clearly demonstrate that the size of end-winding has influence on the winding resistance and, consequently, the power loss in the AC operation. The theoretical prediction of the losses within the armature of the high-speed permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) is validated experimentally on a segmented stator.

articleTitle: Control of electromechanical object with backlash and elasticity within interconnection between motor and load
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: In this paper, an analysis of various control structures for two-mass drive system with backlash are presented. Theoretical model of this complex mechanical system is derived and presented. Conventional PI speed controller is compared with 2DOF-PID controller considering delays in control path and location of resonances, PID controller with additional feedback signals and fuzzy PD-I controller. The comparison of the control process and its dynamics is based on integral and time-domain quality factors.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of hysteresis based control and finite control state set Model Predictive Control of Shunt Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This paper presents a comparison of two control strategies for 3-level 4-leg Shunt Active Power Filter (SAPF). The first method is based on hysteresis controllers and the second, proposed method is the Model Predictive Control (MPC) with a finite control states set (FS). The two methods are described and experimental results are presented with comparison.

articleTitle: The impact of converter's synchronization during FRT voltage recovery in two-phase short circuits
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This article aims to examine the impact of synchronisation methods on transient phenomena occurring during a short-term voltage sag. The study was conducted for several synchronisation algorithms during interference from a short-term two-phase short-circuit. The research results show that in a state of transition of reduced and unbalanced voltage the best inverter results are obtained for fast-synchronisation algorithms which generate a synchronisation signal adequate to the voltage distortion. In contrast, the greatest threat turned out to be big oscillations of active power during work with advanced, time-consuming synchronisation algorithms. These oscillations adversely affect the mechanical components, particularly on the drive train system of a wind power plant if the plant uses the Fault Ride Through procedure.

articleTitle: Estimation of electromagnetic parameters of an induction motor multi-loop equivalent circuit based on the machine inductance frequency characteristic
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The variability of electromagnetic parameters of induction motors with deep-bar cage or solid rotors is represented, with a satisfactory approximation, by the machine secondary multi-loop equivalent circuit with constant lumped parameters. An estimation procedure of electromagnetic parameters of such an equivalent circuit is presented in the paper. The procedure is carried out using the measured frequency characteristic determined on the basis of instantaneous values of investigated induction motor electromechanical quantities. The study has been subjected to an induction motor with a solid rotor manufactured from the magnetic material, i.e. a machine characterized by a significant skin effect occurring in rotor solid conductive elements.

articleTitle: Results of load's observation for selected marine electric power plants systems in floating objects
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: Some aspects of marine electric power plants load registration and identification have been presented. Methods of operating data collecting about marine electric power plant loads have been shown based on an example of three vessels - a chemical tanker, a container ship and a tanker. Power plants of these vessels have been described. Examples of collected operating data were presented. Range of marine electric power plant load identification research has been characterized, which presented in the paper results are a part of.

Author Keywords: marine electric power plants mean loads

articleTitle: Simple scanning methods for a Global-MPP determination in a PV string
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: Partial shading and/or mismatch of photovoltaic (PV) modules can cause multiple maxima to occur in their power-voltage curves which can mislead conventional Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithms. This relates both to residential installations and large-scale power plants and can result in significant drop in the overall energy yield. To overcome this problem, a new approach generally referred to as Global Maximum Power Point Searching (GMPPS) has emerged. GMPPS methods based on power-voltage curve scanning are able to obtain optimum operating point in a very short time, regardless of the irradiation profile. This paper presents two methods utilizing external circuitry in order to scan the power-voltage curve of the PV string and determine its maximum power. First method utilizes a MOSFET acting as variable resistive load, whereas the latter is based on forcing the PV current using an switched inductor. Simulation study followed by the experimental verification is presented for both methods.

articleTitle: Assessing of the tripping effectiveness of fuses in electrical installation fed from a synchronous generator set
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The paper presents a simply method for assessing the effectiveness of fast automatic disconnection of supply (electric shock protection) based on measurement of Joule's integral and thermal equivalent current in 230/400 V electrical installations fed from a synchronous generator sets. Experimental studies are carried out under short-circuit conditions using Electronic Phase Detector and Joule Integral Measurement device utilizing 5.5 kVA salient pole synchronous generator protected by gF and gG class fuses.

articleTitle: The influence of skin effect on the accuracy of eddy current energy loss calculation in electrical steel sheets
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the influence of skin effect on the scope of Bertotti formula utilization for describing the energy loss in electrical steel sheets. The paper determines maximum frequency with negligible impact of skin effect on the distribution of magnetic flux in electrical steel sheet. Verification of the results was achieved using loss measurement data for electrical sheets with silicon content of 3% and 6.5%.

articleTitle: Internal pressure diagnostic of vacuum circuit breaker based on the phenomenon of chopping current
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This article presents one of the methods proposed in the literature for examining the status of the vacuum by measuring the chopping current. This phenomenon was studied in a chamber with a pressure control where chopped AC and DC currents were measured. A method of statistical analysis of arcing time and chopped current based on Weibull distribution was developed. The results give rise to a continuation of its practical application.

articleTitle: Sensitivity of a thermal model of the PMSM to uncertainty in estimation of a heat transfer coefficient
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for estimation of the heat transfer coefficient from the motor housing, with application to a synchronous machine with permanent magnets (PMSM). Sensitivity of a thermal model of the motor to the measurement uncertainties in the estimated coefficient is effectively analysed. In order to validate correctness of the calculation results, measurements on the physical model of the machine are carried out.

articleTitle: Core losses model of switched reluctance motor
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The paper deals with a mathematical model of switched reluctance motor, with stator of on induction motor. The parameters of this model were determined experimentally. The motor winding were supplied from different frequencies AC voltage source. Based on the measurements of current and voltage equivalent resistance and inductance of motor windings as a function of frequency were determined using the least squares method. The measurements for different rotation angle of the rotor were carried out. The measured resistance value was significantly higher than the value of the winding resistance because of “iron losses”. The losses are modeled as the losses of a single turn wound on the rotor core, representing the eddy currents circuit. The losses are dependent on the angle of the rotor rotation relative to the stator. Based on the relationship between the equivalent inductance and resistance of the motor measured and specified of the model, the parameters were determined.

articleTitle: Low power test pattern generator for BIST
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: In the last years designers mainly concentrate on low power consumption in mobile computing devices and cellular phones. In this article new solutions for reducing a switching activity of Built-In Self Test (BIST) environment for the scan-organized BIST architectures is presented. The key idea behind this technique is based on the designing a new structure of LFSR to generate more than one pseudo random bit per one clock pulse. Theoretical calculations were hardware verified in two digital systems design environment: WebPACK ISE by Xilinx and Quartus II by Altera. Power consumption measure tools were Xilinx XPower and Altera PowerPlay Power Analyzer Tool. The practical verification covers power consumption of the Test Patternd Generator (TPG) as well as the complete BIST. Achieved results are over a dozen percent better comparing to a similar works. The paper is organized as follows. In section 2, the power consumption issue and weighted switching activity modeling are investigated, section 3 presents new algorithm for bits generation, in section 4 new approach of TPG is presented, section 5 describes tool for VHDL code generation, in section 6 research methodology is presented. Section 7 contains hardware verification of new approaches. In part 8 are presented results measured for the whole BIST and section 9 is the summary.

articleTitle: Soft magnetic materials for energy-efficient electric motors
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The paper presents different types of soft magnetic materials, which may be used for manufacturing of magnetic cores of energy-efficient electric motors. The properties of these materials are compared and their prospective influence on the efficiency of electric motors is discussed.

articleTitle: Laboratory tests of a PM-BLDC motor drive
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The paper presents the developed drive system with a brushless DC (BLDC) motor, for which laboratory tests have been performed. Research has been carried out for two speed control methods: using an inverter (by pulse width modulation) and controlling the voltage value applied to the converter. Laboratory tests of the drive system have been performed on the developed research stand. Waveforms of electrical and mechanical quantities as well as operating parameters of the drive system have been measured and compared for both ways of speed control.

articleTitle: Electrical energy recovery from network water pressure
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The paper presents the potential possibilities of energy recovery during reduction of pressure in the heating networks. The main aim is to substitute the existing mechanical pressure reducing valve. For this purpose, sample analysis was carried out and later, a model of a device based on pump components for energy recovery from water pressures was constructed and tested in a laboratory. The main elements of the model are: the turbine housing and rotor, mechanical seal block, flexible coupling, bearings and a permanent magnet synchronous generator. The output of the generator is connected with a power electronics unit which converts and returns produced energy to a single-phase power grid (230V, 50Hz). Preliminary studies show possibilities to achieve a satisfying efficiency of energy conversion and point the way for the future research and development activities.

articleTitle: The impact of parameter control on the characteristics of switched reluctance motor designed for small electric vehicle drive
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The article discusses the issue of the impact of parameter control on the characteristics of switched reluctance motor. The four-phase motor 8/6 under analysis is intended for small electric car drives. In the case of electric car drive the work with extended constant power range is significant. The standard control enables the sustenance of the constant power range to the constant moment range rate at approximately 3:1. With the use of continuous conduction mode (CCM) control the extension of constant power is possible. Both standard and CCM control was tested in laboratory conditions. The results of laboratory tests together with the conclusions have been presented.

articleTitle: Determination of the optimal multi-slot coaxial antenna sizes based on the microwave antenna reflection coefficient characteristics
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This paper describes a method of determination of the optimal sizes and locations of cylindrical air gaps inside the multi-slot coaxial antenna operating at 2.45 GHz. The dimensions of the microwave antenna with a 50-ohm coaxial feed were revised with regard to antenna reflection coefficient distributions. It should be emphasized that there are some differences between the operating frequencies of such antennas described in the literature and the resonant frequencies obtained from the antenna characteristics. It may significantly affect the interstitial hyperthermia treatment. It is also possible to resize the antenna slots to minimalize the S11-parameter value and obtain the best antenna impedance matching inside various tissues commonly treated in this method. The numerical implementation of such multi-physical problem is based on the finite element method.

articleTitle: Generators with permanent magnets used in small wind power plants
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The paper presents the design of two multipole generators with permanent magnets designed by the author as well as selected results of tests conducted on them. The generators are used in small wind power plants with horizontal axis wind turbines (HAWT) and vertical axis wind turbines (VAWT). Thanks to unique, patented construction of the magnetic circuit, a very small clogging torque was obtained in spite of a big number of rotor poles and straight-teeth stator slots. The paper describes the design of generators, the dependence of voltage on rotational speed at idle, the dependence of voltage on load for the rated speed as well as measurements of the cogging torque. The generators can be used in micro water power plants.

articleTitle: Predictive control of current source rectifier
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The paper presents a new predictive control strategy of current source rectifier (CSR) supplied from the grid. The algorithm chooses proper space vector of CSR according to the predicted value of the grid current and predicted value of the capacitor voltage. Proposed method is analyzed for different L and C values and their influence on higher harmonics reduction has been discussed. Simulation results confirm good performance of the system.

articleTitle: Analysis of local force distribution in a permanent magnet motor using different computational algorithms
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: Electromagnetic force distribution in a high speed permanent magnet motor (HSPM) has been studied. Two algorithms of local force calculation in a 2D finite element model of the machine have been proposed and discussed. Numerical models have been elaborated in the Maxwell and MagNet environment. In the paper, force distribution on a stator surface has been calculated and compared. The no-load operation mode (only magnets generate force) of the machine has been considered. Special attention has been paid to the force acting on a stator tooth.

articleTitle: Chosen research results of switched reluctance motor with asymmetric stator magnetic circuit
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This article presents selected results of 6/4 switched reluctance motor analysis with an asymmetric magnetic circuit of stator. The designed motor is dedicated for multifunction drive of a food processor. In the designed motor one of the phases has modified magnetic and electric parameters. The influence of stator magnetic circuit asymmetry is presented on the example of static characteristics (electromagnetic torque and self-inductance) of two phases of the motor. Waveforms of phase currents, flux-linkages and electromagnetic torque are determined based on the field-circuit model and by using the classical symmetric control method. In laboratory conditions static characteristics are determined. Waveforms of phase currents in different working points of the motor are determined. The relationship of output power, efficiency and rms values of currents in the function of rotor speed are determined for selected control parameters. The research results of constructions with an asymmetric magnetic circuit of stator are related to a commutator motor.

articleTitle: Experimental verification of DC/DC Boost converter calculation model considering conduction losses
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This paper presents experimental verification of mathematical model of Boost DC/DC pulse converter structure with regard to conduction power losses for Continuous Current Mode (CCM). Measured characteristics of efficiency of energy conversion, voltage gain have been presented and compared with theoretical ones. Characteristics obtained on the basis of the model proposed in [1] well approximate experimental ones. Thus, the proposed model is suitable for converter projecting with the possibility to achieve predetermined efficiency of energy conversion and voltage gain at the stage of selection of converter elements.

articleTitle: From simple experiments to modern mechatronic devices-development of MR fluid applications
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: Smart materials, especially MR fluids, play more and more important role in mastering and optimizing construction of mechatronic systems. In the paper the structure and the properties of magnetorheological (MR) fluids are briefly described. The author proposes the series of laboratory experiments reflecting progress in development of systems with MR fluids. In the paper the following exemplary devices with MR fluids are considered: magnetorheological damper, magnetorheological brake, magnetorheological rotary-linear brake and magnetorheological clutch. The chosen results of measurements for laboratory experiments carried out in the Department of Mechatronics at Silesian University of Technology (Poland, Gliwice) are given.

articleTitle: Kinect as modern user interface tool
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The purpose of this work was to design interface and write software to recognize gesture and voice commands using Kinect. Library and demonstration programs were developed. Everything was written in C# using Microsoft Visual Studio. Software was tested in aim to remove errors..

articleTitle: Numerical analyses of a radial flux motor with a double-sided rotor, Nd-Fe-B magnets and the soft magnetic composite stator: Part 1
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The paper deals with numerical analyses of a radial flux motor with double-sided rotor. The motor was designed with Nd-Fe-B sintered magnets and soft magnetic stator made of iron powder. The motor was designed for assessment of possibility of construction high torque motors with the powder stator for e.g. electric vehicles or washing machines. The motor is assumed to have stator composed from segmented parts made of iron powder. Those parts are assumed to be made by pressing the powder in a die or cut from larger parts by electric discharge machining. The motor stator was designed with uses of special construction powder components and is subjected of a Polish patent application. Designed stator should have better mechanical performance than stator made of electrical steel.

articleTitle: The calculation of the inrush current peak value of superconducting transformers
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This paper presents results of analysis of inrush current phenomenon with regards to transformers with windings made of superconducting materials. The analysis focused on the impact of the form of the superconductor transition characteristic from the superconducting to the resistive state on the current pulse wave. Moreover, a formula was derived for dependence of inrush current peak value of superconducting transformers. The impact of modification of arguments in the equation on inrush current peak value was analysed and corresponding characteristics were drawn.

articleTitle: Energy analysis of electric machine with hybrid excitation and flux switching
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This paper presents results the analysis of mechanisms of generation of electromagnetic torque in Flux Switching Hybrid Excitation Machine (HEFSM). Due to the double-excitation of the machine (magnets and electromagnetic) and the teeth of both the stator and the rotor, these mechanisms are potentially much more numerous in comparison to the other electrical machines. In the Analysis takes into account the influence of the saturation of the magnetic circuit for the generation of torque, due to its presence during normal operation. The second objective of this Analysis was to formulate a energetic reliable machine model. Calculation was based on the nonlinear FEM 2D model of machine.

articleTitle: Fiber optic position sensor establishing the position of the power cut off switch
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The article presents the concept and measurement results of the position sensor establishing the position of the power cut off switch arm. Composed structure uses the fiber optic head. The use of fiber optics enables to place such a sensor in the environment of strong electromagnetic fields and provides galvanic isolation. To measure the angular position of the earthing blade of the cut off switch in the range from 0 to 14° and the step equal 2.5°, the head composed of five reflective intensity-based sensors connected in parallel was used. POF (Plastic Optical Fiber, Polymer Optical Fiber) fiber optics with a diameter of 1mm were used to compose the sensor model. These fiber optics enables easy and inexpensive coupling with dedicated sources and detectors and also simple processing of optical paths in the sensor placement.

articleTitle: Measurements of Shape Memory Alloy actuator for a self-switching electrical fuse
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This paper describes chosen results of the measurements of various characteristics of Shape Memory Alloy wire in purpose of its usage as an actuator for self-switching electrical fuse. The experiments were performed by talented pupil of secondary school as a research project co-financed by Polish Ministry of Science and Higher Education. Measurement system consisting of power supply unit PSH-3620a and PC computer with running LabVIEW application is used to control the measurement procedures. Program of experiments consists of static measurements (static switching current), dynamic measurements (switching times) and exploitation measurements (switch off time). The paper presents chosen resultant characteristics.

articleTitle: Simulation of grounding networks in the SES CDEGS software
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The article presents a new concept in the area of mathematical modeling of grounding networks. The idea is to combine a few arbitrary homogeneities (finite volumes of prismatic shape), defined in the MALT module of SES CDEGS software by its developers, to build the polyhedron much more useful in grounding system simulations (finite length cylinder, semi-cylindrical trough or sphere). The polyhedron, with resistivity different than surrounding soil, is created from a several finite volumes that can each be defined separately by 24 numbers in rectangular Cartesian coordinate system. Every finite volume has a shape of hexahedron. The six faces of the volume are convex tetragons.

articleTitle: Synchronization process of permanent magnet synchronous motor from over synchronous speed
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of a numerical analysis of the process of synchronizing a medium-power permanent magnet synchronous motor. The investigated motor has a switchable stator winding whereby the number of stator field poles can be changed and (two-stage) starting to a speed higher than the rated one and synchronization from a supersynchronous speed can be effected. The numerical analysis of the synchronization process was carried out using a field-circuit model of the motor.

articleTitle: Groups of matrices modulo k
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: Integer matrices, in particular (0, 1)-matrices, are widely used not only in modern mathematics, but also in computer science and its applications, like designing and programming intelligent systems. The aim of this paper is to introduce a group action on binary matrices and to generalize it to integer matrices, and to present possibilities of their use in the new concept of the electromechanical device that could be helpful in the treatment of aphasia.

articleTitle: Specifying the ferrofluid parameters important from the viewpoint of magnetic fluid hyperthermia
publicationTitle: 2015 Selected Problems of Electrical Engineering and Electronics (WZEE)
abstract: The article presents the experimental study of magnetic fluid hyperthermia (MFH) utilizing magnetite nanoparticles with diameter of 15.2 nm. Temperature measurements of the ferrofluid samples were carried out in real measurement system using parallel resonance phenomenon. Based on the obtained temperature curves the basic heating parameters of ferrofluid, namely the Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) and power losses in tested nanoparticles have been specified. The authors systematize the current knowledge of these quantities and additionally propose two models that simplify their determination with given errors, omitting the mass and volume concentrations of the individual components of magnetic fluid.
